## Who am I

::: {.work-section}

I'm an NLP Engineer at **[Xbites](https://xbites.io)**, building the AI backend for Darin.

I also research with **[Hamza Salem Lab](https://www.enghamzasalem.com/)** on Arabic embeddings and contribute to **[NAMMA](https://www.namaa.space/)** for open-source Arabic AI.

My thesis focuses on making transformers run efficiently on CPUs. I write about [Arabic NLP](/blog/feed.html), [embedding models](/blog/posts/nlp/embedding_world/index.html), and [building production AI systems](/blog/posts/seo/how_i_use_nlp_for_seo.html).
